text.offer: Heroic champion of the Fist, will you give of yourself so that your Lord may be stronger? Worship with me, then. Together, we will draw upon our own life essence to forge a symbol of our Lord's power. Incant these words with me: By the spark of steel against steel, I summon thee, Kraanan the Fist.
text.progress: The realm's shrines stand in the Forest Shrine past Marion, the Badlands beyond Barloque, the orc caves beyond Tos, the necromancers' arena at Brax and the citizen's market of Barloque. Drop the offering on the ground beside one.
text.complete: Word has spread of your offering: the shrine is Kraanan's for a day, and all who wield Kraanan's magic are stronger for it. Come back tomorrow, and we will chant again.

steps.brief: Ah, this is a great day for Kraanan! Go now, carry forth the strength of our Lord into the world! Placed at one of the Shrines around the world, it will dedicate the Shrine to Kraanan.
